name: Local Principal Model
description: Define the local principal: how a user or agent authenticates locally, what capabilities they have by default, and how local identity maps to account identity.
purpose: Establish the fundamental principal model that governs all local identity within a Tribunus cell — every authenticated entity derives from this primitive.
acceptanceCriteria: Local principal schema defined with identity primitives and capability defaults
Agent principals distinguished from user principals
Local authentication mechanism specified (keychain, biometric, passphrase)
Default capability set for unauthenticated, authenticated, and admin principals
